Master.g1.label: Request submitted

intake.submission_channels.summary: Each public agency shall adopt procedures that provide full access, protect records, prevent excessive disruption, provide assistance and information, and ensure efficient and timely action on requests.

intake.written_request_required.summary: A public agency may require a written request for inspection of public records but shall not otherwise require a request in any particular form.
If copies are requested, the public agency may require a written request and advance payment of the prescribed fee.

intake.no_required_form.summary: A public agency shall not require a request to be made in any particular form.

intake.required_fields.summary: A public agency shall not require that a request contain more than the requester's name and address, information necessary to ascertain the records desired, and the requester's right of access.

intake.no_technicality_denial.summary: No request shall be returned, delayed, or denied because of any technicality unless it is impossible to determine the records to which the requester desires access.

production.format_and_medium.authority: Roe v. Phillips Cnty. Hosp., 317 Kan. 1, 522 P.3d 277 (2023)
production.format_and_medium.summary: K.S.A. 45-219(a) requires a public agency, upon request, to provide a copy of a public record in the format in which the agency maintains that record.

production.certified_copy.summary: Where access to records or their permitted use is limited under K.S.A. 45-221 or 45-230, the agency may require the requester to certify in writing either a right of access or that the requester will not use/sell any list of names and addresses to sell property or services.

production.inspection_access.summary: Copies shall be made while records are in the custodian's possession/custody/control and under the custodian's supervision; whenever practicable, copies shall be made where the records are kept, and if not practicable the custodian shall allow arrangements for other facilities.
Nothing in the act requires an agency to make electronic copies by allowing a person to attach an electronic device provided by that person to the agency's computer or other electronic device.

production.no_duty_to_create_or_convert.summary: A public agency is not required to provide copies of tapes, discs, video, film, pictures, slides, graphics, illustrations, or similar audio/visual items unless they were shown/played to a public meeting of the governing body; and need not provide items copyrighted by another.

intake.identity_requirement.summary: A public agency may require proof of identity of any person requesting access to a public record.

eligibility.any_person.summary: All public records shall be open for inspection by any person, except as otherwise provided by the act; each public agency must make suitable facilities available for inspection.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A public agency shall not require a request to contain more than the requester's name and address and the information necessary to ascertain the records and the requester's right of access; no general statement of purpose is required.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: No residency or citizenship qualification is imposed on the right to request; the right runs to 'any person.'

custody.referral_to_proper_custodian.summary: If the person to whom the request is directed is not the custodian, that person shall notify the requester and furnish the custodian's name and location, if known or readily ascertainable.

Except for multi-agency summary data or as otherwise provided by law, requests for records held in the KBI-maintained central/criminal-justice repositories shall be directed to the criminal justice agency from which the records originated.

Except for multi-agency summary data or as otherwise provided by law, requests for records in the KBI-maintained Kansas asset seizure and forfeiture repository shall be directed to the law enforcement agency from which the records originated.

Requests for records defined as 'files' under K.S.A. 75-4379 submitted to a state or local law enforcement or governmental agency shall be directed to the agency that made, maintained, or kept such files.

Requests for records containing captured license plate data or pertaining to the location of an automated license plate recognition system shall be directed to the agency that owns, leases, or contracts for the system.

waiver.notes: KORA has no fee-waiver framework (no public-interest/indigency grounds, no purpose statement, no written-denial or appeal for waiver). fee.labor_charge.summary: Actual costs may include the cost to review and redact the requested records but shall not include incidental costs not attributable to furnishing the requested records.
Charges for staff time shall be based on the employee's salary or hourly wage and shall not include the costs of employee benefits.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: Fees for copies shall not exceed the actual cost of furnishing the requested records, including the cost of staff time required to make the information available.
If the agency incurs staff-time costs, it shall use in good faith the lowest-cost category of staff reasonably necessary to provide access or furnish copies.
If it is necessary to use other facilities for copying, the requester shall pay that cost; the agency may also charge the same supervision fee as for furnishing copies under subsection (c).

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: Fees for providing access to records maintained on computer facilities shall include only the cost of any computer services, including staff time required.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: Except where fees are prescribed by statute or subsection (h) applies, each public agency may prescribe reasonable fees for providing access to or furnishing copies of public records, subject to enumerated limits.

custody.custodian_definition_and_role.summary: The 'official custodian' is any officer/employee responsible for maintaining public records (regardless of actual personal custody); 'custodian' includes any person the official custodian designates.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: Each official custodian shall designate the persons necessary to carry out custodian duties and shall ensure a custodian is available during regular business hours.

communication.determination_notice.summary: Each public agency shall, upon request of any person, provide its principal office and office hours, the title and address of the official custodian and any ordinarily-available custodian, the fees charged, and the procedures for requesting records.
